notes: Establishes the exact colourway the user selected: 8CQ, sold as 8CQ/U1. Frame transparent purple, lenses pink. Size 55-17-140.

ALIASES ARE COLOUR-SCOPED ON PURPOSE. Every alias binds the model to 8CQ. Bare 'SPARKS' or bare '8CQ' are deliberately excluded: SPARKS/G/S ships at least three pink-ish colourways (8CQ, 8CO, 1N5) and a colour-agnostic alias would admit the wrong frame — the failure the exact-variant rule exists to prevent.
COLOUR IS CONTESTED ACROSS RETAILERS for this same code: violet, transparent purple, cherry and pink all appear. The public colour must be decided from the acquired frames, not from retailer text.

ALIAS OBSERVED IN PASS 1'S OWN REJECTION LOG, not guessed: the retailer's asset path collapses the slashes entirely — SPARKS/G/S becomes 'sparksgs' — giving '...-sparksgs-8cq-55...'. The pass-1 alias set carried SPARKSGS8CQ and SPARKS-G-S-8CQ and missed that separator form by one hyphen. Still colour-scoped: every alias binds the model to 8CQ.
Second independent listing of the same code, describing it as pink cat-eye at size 55. Corroborates the code and the model; contributes no image.
Product type: angular cat-eye women's sunglasses. ONE SIZE for the Mall; 55-17-140 is an eyewear measurement, not a size ladder.
